_zelenszki_: Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki came from Lindenbruck, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Verdel Ridge is lost. Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A bullet went through Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki's sleeve at S-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Clement "Lucky" Johnrant of the Concord (@johnrant21). After what happened at the Brickworks, Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki asked to serve as a stretcher bearer. Nobody argued.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki went out with the wiring party at S-F16. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki stretched a scrap of canvas over the letters. Everything else could get wet first.
Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki carried three men out of S-F16 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not.
Walter Mat drew a map of Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki's hometown from Owl's stories. Owl says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.

A bullet hit Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki in the neck at S-F16. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Albin Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4). A single shot at S-F16. Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Albin Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4).
Ulrich Zelenszki asked about Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki on arriving at S-F16. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

Ulrich Zelenszki was on the dawn watch at S-F16 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Ulrich Zelenszki was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Zeno Owenhart of the Concord (@owenhart247). The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Ulrich Zelenszki did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

The wound Ulrich Zelenszki shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ulrich Zelenszki is number 164. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Victory at Grey Mill. Ulrich Zelenszki let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Ulrich Zelenszki returned to S-F16 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Ulrich Zelenszki found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.

Ulrich Zelenszki spent the afternoon chasing his cap across the trench. It stopped every time he did, and jumped away again when he reached for it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Zelenszki. Ulrich Zelenszki read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Ulrich Zelenszki reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Asked what he will do after the war, Ulrich Zelenszki said: 'Be a printer's apprentice in Lindenbruck. And never complain about anything, ever again.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Zelenszki. Ulrich Zelenszki read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich Zelenszki crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Gideon "Shadow" Owenhart reached for a rifle. Ulrich Zelenszki was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@owenhart247) The Concord sentry, Severin Moovin, shouted once. Ulrich Zelenszki silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@da_moovin)
A bullet grazed Ulrich Zelenszki's ribs at S-F16. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Arno Ricks of the Concord (@sam.ricks).

Ulrich was carrying water up to S-F16 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Ulrich did not. Shot by Silas Charlieshort of the Concord (@charlieshort5.0). Ulrich finally has a bed in the field hospital. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
chirotama63: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Silas Chirotama. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Silas Chirotama said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Silas Chirotama kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home found Silas Chirotama before the night shift. Silas Chirotama folded it small and kept it close.

Silas Chirotama sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Silas Chirotama answered to number 602. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-S17. Silas Chirotama has learned to walk bent double.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Silas Chirotama. The men named it the Judge and said it had chosen him.
Casimir Nile and Silas Chirotama have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
the Judge the crow follows Silas Chirotama along the trench now. When the Judge flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
Silas Chirotama took a message across the Brickworks at dusk. The message arrived. Silas Chirotama did not.
Silas Chirotama came back to R-S17 after sheltering with another unit. He brought a note confirming the story and a borrowed mug to return.
Somebody in R-S17 wanted to shoot the Judge for the pot. Silas Chirotama stood in front of the rifle. The matter has been dropped.
Silas was handed a boot full of water and a man with a hole in his foot. He dealt with both.
giftk0: Marek Giftk reported to N-F8 with a rosary of rough beads sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Marek Giftk was hit in the foot through his boot at N-F8. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Rafael "Saint" Sureshot of the Concord (@sureshot1021).
Marek Giftk held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.

Silas Giftk arrived carrying the family name of Marek Giftk. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Silas Giftk's transfer to the role of rifleman was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

The Concord sentry, Casimir Peraltaa, shouted once. Silas Giftk silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@facundo.peraltaa) Silas Giftk went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits.

A bullet grazed Silas Giftk's ribs at N-F8. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Dorian "Mud" Prime of the Concord (@xerod.prime). Silas Giftk got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.

Three days with a bandage, and Silas is back at N-F8. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. The corporal called out the mail. Silas heard the name and almost ran.
mitaylor_1776: Bram "Crow" Mitaylor arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a dented harmonica and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Bram "Crow" Mitaylor received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Bram "Crow" Mitaylor started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."

A single shot from across the wire hit Bram "Crow" Mitaylor in the thigh at S-F5. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple). The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F5 changed before the cheering ended. Bram "Crow" Mitaylor shouldered another load.
There was no room for Bram "Crow" Mitaylor. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Oskar Mitaylor arrived carrying the family name of Bram "Crow" Mitaylor. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Albin Travismac and Oskar Mitaylor split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
A flare lit the Ossuary Wood like noon. Oskar Mitaylor counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
A newspaper reached Oskar Mitaylor with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.

Oskar Mitaylor came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Oskar Mitaylor shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Oskar Mitaylor drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. Oskar Mitaylor got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 223. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Oskar Mitaylor could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
A medic stopped by Oskar Mitaylor's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Oskar Mitaylor had gone back to S-F5.

A round came through the loophole Oskar Mitaylor was watching at S-F5 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Jonas "Brick" Ware of the Concord (@grizzly_ware). Oskar Mitaylor was killed outright at S-F5, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Jonas "Brick" Ware of the Concord (@grizzly_ware).
The papers connected Emil "Hollow" Mitaylor to Oskar Mitaylor. The men took longer to learn Emil "Hollow" Mitaylor's own habits, but they made the effort.
Emil "Hollow" Mitaylor and Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Emil "Hollow" Mitaylor changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Emil "Hollow" Mitaylor of the Hegemony spotted Bastian Mrbojo of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Ossuary Wood. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.

On a quiet night Emil "Hollow" Mitaylor (Hegemony) and Isidor "Saint" Kaline (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
At Blackwater Canal, Emil of the Hegemony and Dietrich Realpayton of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
quinn.morgan: Bram Morgan reported to T-S11 with a book with the last pages torn out sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Bram Morgan heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Bram Morgan waited under a load that got heavier by the minute. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Bram Morgan wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Bram Morgan pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Verdel Ridge and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him.
A bullet clipped Bram Morgan's helmet at T-S11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Nils Sandorthehou of the Hegemony (@sandorthehound).
The medic cut the last bandage off Bram Morgan's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to T-S11 the same hour.
Matthias Tommaso lent Bram Morgan a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
The tapping under Verdel Ridge is closer. Bram Morgan and two others work in silence, in socks, by the light of one candle.
Bram Morgan and Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
A round came through the loophole Bram was watching at T-S11 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke of the Hegemony (@logancooke97).
ryan.alfeo: By the time Quentin Alfeo reached S-C4, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Quentin Alfeo watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home found Quentin Alfeo before the night shift. Quentin Alfeo folded it small and kept it close.

Quentin Alfeo found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin Alfeo is number 736. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Quentin Alfeo stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Quentin Alfeo tried to remember the price of a loaf in Coldwater. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. A letter from home found Quentin Alfeo before the night shift. Quentin Alfeo folded it small and kept it close.
Quentin Alfeo keeps the photograph in his pocket next to his brother's pocket watch. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A sniper's bullet hit Quentin Alfeo at S-C4. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Quentin Alfeo. He died on the stretcher before morning.
Casimir Alfeo arrived carrying the family name of Quentin Alfeo. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Casimir Alfeo sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.

Casimir Alfeo carried Cyril Kennethm's rifle all the way up to Hill 304 after Cyril twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to. A letter for Casimir Alfeo came with a photograph. Casimir Alfeo looked at it for a long time and said nothing.

Casimir Alfeo set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come. The letter for Casimir Alfeo ended with 'come home soon'. Casimir Alfeo read the last line more than the rest.

Casimir saved the last of the sugar for Marek Delgado's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Marek's birthday. It was a good day anyway. The runner said a letter for Casimir had come up with the ammunition. Casimir went to get it before the ammunition.
sebastian.v6900: Nobody asked Cyril Sebastian why he came. Nobody in T-F7 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Cyril Sebastian looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A single shot from across the wire hit Cyril Sebastian in the thigh at T-F7. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Severin Kole of the Hegemony (@aleksandar.kole). Cyril Sebastian was hit at T-F7 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Severin Kole of the Hegemony (@aleksandar.kole).

The House of Sebastian sent Otto Sebastian after Cyril Sebastian. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Otto Sebastian watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
The corporal found out Otto Sebastian used to be a railway porter. Otto Sebastian has been doing two jobs ever since.

Otto Sebastian had just lit a cigarette at T-F7 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins of the Hegemony (@hogggogins).
The wound on Otto Sebastian's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
A splinter of duckboard, kicked up by a shell, went into Otto Sebastian's calf. The medic pulled it out with pliers. Otto Sebastian did not make a sound.

A bullet struck Otto Sebastian below the ribs at T-F7. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Bram Ordaz of the Hegemony (@matthew.ordaz12). Otto Sebastian looked over the parapet at T-F7 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Bram Ordaz of the Hegemony (@matthew.ordaz12).
The House of Sebastian sent another. Gideon Sebastian, father of Otto Sebastian, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A patient at the aid post asked Gideon Sebastian for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen.
A shot from across the wire took the top off Gideon's mess tin at T-F7. His wrist stung for an hour. Dinner was ruined. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin of the Hegemony (@halil.ibrahim.timucin).
seths110: Ulrich Seths arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a photograph gone soft at the edges and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Ulrich Seths made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Seths. Ulrich Seths read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A loose thread in Ulrich Seths's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Seths. Ulrich Seths read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich Seths watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A clear shot from R-F1. Ulrich Seths grazed Otto Johannmigano and slid back down below the parapet.

Ulrich Seths had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Seths. Ulrich Seths read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Ulrich Seths reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

A recruit asked Ulrich Seths how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Seths. Ulrich Seths read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
At R-F1 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Ulrich Seths won the bet. Otto Johannmigano was gravely wounded.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F1 in the middle of the night. Ulrich Seths met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Bastian Nodrag of the Concord (@highspeed_nodrag1833).
The House of Seths sent Marek Seths after Ulrich Seths. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Marek Seths shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Anselm Whispertooth, was grazed. Marek Seths got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 315. The men who came later will ask about it. Marek Seths's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Marek Seths helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Marek Seths fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Bastian Mrbojo, now grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Seths. Marek Seths read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Marek Seths. The men named it Old Tom and said it had chosen him.

Listening post, three in the morning. Marek Seths heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Seths. Marek Seths read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Marek Seths was carrying water up to R-F1 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Marek Seths did not. Shot by Ivo "Brick" Tendmother of the Concord (@sovi_tendmother).
No bed for Marek Seths yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.

Marek Seths never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Marek Seths got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.

Old Tom the crow follows Marek along the trench now. When Old Tom flies off, men duck. They are usually right to. The letter for Marek had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Marek dried it by the stove, page by page.
sevr.png: Isidor "Rabbit" Png reached U-F12 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Isidor "Rabbit" Png spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Isidor "Rabbit" Png did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Isidor "Rabbit" Png fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Nils Peterpederpe was gravely wounded trying to cross it.
Isidor "Rabbit" Png kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Isidor "Rabbit" Png fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F12. Roland Bfitzy was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
A bullet grazed Isidor "Rabbit" Png's ribs at U-F12. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson of the Concord (@evanrobinson4578).
The medic cut the last bandage off Isidor "Rabbit" Png's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to U-F12 the same hour.
Isidor "Rabbit" Png fired at a movement across the wire at U-F12. The man went down: Clement "Parson" Krut, badly wounded.

Isidor swept the enemy parapet at U-F12 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Zeno Bfitzy was grazed. Isidor smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob came out for a cup and was grazed.
sleepyfive.3: Wendel Sleepyfive arrived with the Day 12 draft, carrying his brother's pocket watch and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Roland "Button" Lahetta (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at Sorrow Copse. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Wendel Sleepyfive: 'Fair trade.' A letter from home reached Wendel Sleepyfive before dusk. Wendel Sleepyfive read it twice and slept a little easier.

A man asked Wendel Sleepyfive to describe Halden without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. A letter from home reached Wendel Sleepyfive before dusk. Wendel Sleepyfive read it twice and slept a little easier.

A flare caught Wendel Sleepyfive halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. A letter from home reached Wendel Sleepyfive before dusk. Wendel Sleepyfive read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wendel Sleepyfive went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Leopold "Ghost" Warm was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@jarm_the_warm) A letter from home found Wendel Sleepyfive before the night shift. Wendel Sleepyfive folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel Sleepyfive washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Wendel Sleepyfive, and the soup went cold while Wendel Sleepyfive read it.
Wendel watched a patrol leave the trench at V-F14 and counted them out. Later he counted them in. A letter came for Wendel with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Wendel pinned it to the dugout wall.
spencerbonthoux: The new rifleman gave his name as Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
The men have learned that Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth is always the first one awake. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.

Thunder shook dust from the beams over Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth. The man beside him asked whether the sky had the correct range. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.

Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth was hit through the chest at R-F11. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Teodor Acakostic of the Hegemony (@acakostic11). Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. The worst has passed for Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.

A surgeon stopped at Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news. A letter from home found Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth before the night shift. Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth folded it small and kept it close. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth is back from the field hospital, thinner and quieter, with a bullet that missed him still in his pocket. Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth became a sniper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. A letter from home found Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth before the night shift. Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth folded it small and kept it close.
Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth aimed a step ahead and fired: Teodor Acakostic, gravely wounded.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F11. Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Nils Oreo of the Hegemony (@theo.oreo.11).

Dorian Spencerbonth joined R-F11 under the shadow of Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Dorian Spencerbonth answered the first call, number 22 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.

Dorian Spencerbonth fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Roland "Mud" Acakostic was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Dorian Spencerbonth wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Dorian Spencerbonth shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Edmund Ahmadhcj, was grazed.

Dorian Spencerbonth was hit in the forearm at R-F11. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Marek Berkaatilla of the Hegemony (@berkaatilla).
Dorian Spencerbonth's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

A sniper's bullet hit Dorian Spencerbonth at R-F11. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Oskar "Rabbit" Nathan of the Hegemony (@nathan156910). Dorian Spencerbonth was killed at R-F11 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Oskar "Rabbit" Nathan of the Hegemony (@nathan156910).
A letter came with Marek Spencerbonth: "I am Dorian Spencerbonth's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-F11 in the middle of the night. Marek Spencerbonth met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h).
The papers say Henrik Spencerbonth. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Marek Spencerbonth's eyes. Nobody in R-F11 argues.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F11. Henrik Spencerbonth took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_). Henrik Spencerbonth was killed on watch at R-F11. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_).
Yann Spencerbonth had heard about Henrik Spencerbonth's courage. At R-F11, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Yann smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Gideon "Parson" Gibbons came out for a cup and was grazed. Yann cut his hand to the bone on the wire at the Hanging Bridge. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic.
theo.oreo.11: Nils Oreo joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Nils Oreo went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Concord trench a man turned around too late. Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth did not get up again. (@spencerbonthoux) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Nils Oreo snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Nils Oreo free. The worst has passed for Nils Oreo. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-C11 changed before the cheering ended. Nils Oreo shouldered another load. A letter from home found Nils Oreo before the night shift. Nils Oreo folded it small and kept it close.

The bearers moved Nils Oreo's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. A letter from home found Nils Oreo before the night shift. Nils Oreo folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Nils Oreo is number 709 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Nils Oreo shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Nils Oreo never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Nils Oreo flashed a lamp signal to the battery behind the ridge. The answer came back: a single word, misspelled.
Nils Oreo sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Nils Oreo took it personally.

Nils Oreo took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-C11, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Florian Oaustin of the Concord (@oaustin77).

A medic stopped by Nils Oreo's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Nils Oreo had gone back to R-C11. The censor had blacked out two words in the letter for Nils Oreo. Nils Oreo guessed what they were and laughed.
Nils Oreo tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear.
Nils and Ivo "Shadow" Bucko swapped hats for a day to see if anyone would notice. Nobody did, and both were a little insulted.
topekeno: Felix Topekeno arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
First Wave. Felix Topekeno signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy held the mirror while Felix Topekeno shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Felix Topekeno watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Felix Topekeno tried to remember the price of a loaf in Wyvern Cross. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Felix Topekeno approved the method.

Felix Topekeno and Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Felix Topekeno looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
New laces made Felix Topekeno's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Felix Topekeno went out with a patrol to Saint-Ash crossroads and did not come back with it. He is listed as missing. The men leave his rations untouched.
Someone at R-F12 saved Felix Topekeno's share of the rations. Nobody said why.
Felix Topekeno reappeared at R-F12 carrying a scrap of map from another unit. The route home had been drawn over somebody's shopping list.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Felix Topekeno only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F12, then nothing but pain. Raider: Emil "Lucky" Macwigger of the Hegemony (@macwigger2214). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Felix Topekeno read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The medic looked at Felix Topekeno's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F12. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Felix Topekeno watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Felix Topekeno traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Felix Topekeno and Bastian "Lucky" Vpy share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
A clear shot from R-F12. Felix Topekeno badly wounded Severin Nonly and slid back down below the parapet.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Felix Topekeno's bunk. He has named it Captain.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F12. Felix Topekeno was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Henrik Sergiootd of the Hegemony (@sergiootd).
Another member of the House of Topekeno reached the line: Quentin Topekeno. He asked where Felix Topekeno had slept, then chose a different corner.
Quentin Topekeno was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Quentin laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
tyehawkins: The old hands of N-F21 have been here since Day 1. Florian "Smokes" Tyehawkins has been here since Day 13. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Florian "Smokes" Tyehawkins found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Gustav Godzillasmyb held the mirror while Florian "Smokes" Tyehawkins shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Benedikt Edwinni wrote a song about Lantern Hill. Florian "Smokes" Tyehawkins wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Florian "Smokes" Tyehawkins's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Florian has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
veryprdy: In Varenne, Dietrich Veryprdy was a fisherman. In R-F1, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a fisherman again.

Dietrich Veryprdy started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Veryprdy wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Dietrich Veryprdy fired at a movement across the wire at R-F1. The man went down: Viktor Ssprinklez, badly wounded.
A loose thread in Dietrich Veryprdy's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
Dietrich Veryprdy's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."
Dietrich Veryprdy watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Dietrich Veryprdy heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Dietrich Veryprdy read his diary from the start tonight and laughed at how frightened he was back then. Then he stopped laughing and wrote: "Still here." The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dietrich Veryprdy answered to number 350. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F1 with the rations. Dietrich Veryprdy ate while listening to the revised orders.
The colonel asked who held the line at Hill 304 last night. Every finger pointed at Dietrich Veryprdy. Lance Corporal.
Dietrich Veryprdy laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
Someone in R-F1 asked Dietrich Veryprdy about Varenne. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Dietrich Veryprdy had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Wendel "Spark" Floooring, grazed.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Dietrich Veryprdy read a theatre review while peeling supper.
A bullet clipped Dietrich Veryprdy's helmet at R-F1 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Jakub Tacomeister of the Hegemony (@tacomeister).
Three days with a bandage, and Dietrich is back at R-F1. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
xxirosasxx: The sergeant gave Oskar Xxirosasxx a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 13 or any other. After what happened at Calvary Farm, Oskar Xxirosasxx asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Oskar Xxirosasxx was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. A letter from home found Oskar Xxirosasxx before the night shift. Oskar Xxirosasxx folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Oskar Xxirosasxx across the shin at N-F22. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Hugo Baroosal of the Hegemony (@baroosal). A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Oskar Xxirosasxx aimed a step ahead and fired: Konrad "Button" Jasierralta, grazed.

Oskar Xxirosasxx was hit twice at N-F22, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Severin "Saint" Neurotoxic of the Hegemony (@neurotoxic666). Oskar Xxirosasxx was killed at N-F22 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Severin "Saint" Neurotoxic of the Hegemony (@neurotoxic666).
Karel Xxirosasxx joined N-F22 under the shadow of Oskar Xxirosasxx's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Karel Xxirosasxx took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at N-F22, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Viktor Benb of the Hegemony (@benb0y). There was no room for Karel Xxirosasxx. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Jonas "Owl" Xxirosasxx asked about Karel Xxirosasxx on arriving at N-F22. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Jonas learned a new card game from a man in the next trench. He lost, and was told it was a good start.
